title: Relative Hamming distance under Boolean duality
statement: Let $f$ and $g$ be Boolean functions on the sign cube of dimension $n$. Their relative Hamming distance is unchanged when both functions are replaced by their Boolean duals.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ map the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\\{\\pm1\\}$
The domain is finite and nonempty, and the codomain has decidable equality, as required to define relative Hamming distance
